remainingUncertainty: The WFS is openly queryable and a bounded Córdoba-area sample is verified, but citywide completeness, exact point membership, stable adapter behavior, and admission semantics require serial review. The initial EPSG:4326 no-record response was a request/SRS outcome only.
nextStep: Serial reviewer should independently qualify the WFS request, CRS/axis handling, canonical identity semantics, and bounded sample before any adapter admission.
